sources.name: Project dataset transcripts and reviewed metadata

decision.reason: No project-owner evidence was found that the applicable Analytics & Reporting amendment/permission and retention basis have been confirmed for this use.

conditions_observed_from_official_pages: Additional derived metrics require the applicable amendment and approved analytics use case.
The policy guide states that audited developers must explicitly apply for permission; unapproved use cases must not create additional derived metrics or store beyond the ordinary policy.
Accepted use cases may store specified statistical and derived metrics for up to 36 calendar months, while other API data retains separate refresh/deletion duties.
Derived metrics must be distinguished from YouTube API-sourced metrics and must not be presented as YouTube-approved predictions.

retention.statistical_and_derived_metrics: Do not assume the 36-month allowance until the applicable permission is confirmed.
retention.titles_creator_names_descriptions_commen: Retain/refresh/delete only under the applicable base policy; verify with the project owner.
retention.withdrawal: Block new training/serving, preserve an audit status, and remove or refresh data as the applicable terms require.

required_owner_actions: Confirm whether the Google Cloud/YouTube API project has applied for and received the permission described in the current policy guide.
Record the project/use-case identifier, confirmation date, reviewer, accepted amendment or approval evidence, and permitted retention period without storing credentials.
Confirm rights for transcript reuse independently from permission to read API statistics.
review_note: This record is a technical gate, not legal advice. An agent cannot accept terms or assert project approval for the owner.
